title: Angular Native Application Builder Options
description: Configuration options for @ng-desktop/builders:application, dev-server, and packager targets.

defaultSnippets.label: NgDesktop Application Target
defaultSnippets.description: Minimal native desktop target with auto OS/GPU detection and auto permissions.

os.description: Target desktop operating system. Defaults to the current host OS and derives the native toolkit automatically.
os.markdownDescription: Target desktop OS (`auto`, `linux`, `windows`, `macos`). Defaults to the host OS.

arch.description: Target CPU architecture for the compiled native binary.

cpu.description: Target CPU instruction profile for ahead-of-time Rust codegen.

targetPlatform.description: Optional explicit native UI backend override (derived automatically from 'os' when omitted).

jsEngine.description: Optional embedded JavaScript engine override (defaults to 'jsc' on Linux/macOS and 'quickjs' on Windows).

gpu.description: Native GPU/compositor backend preference (overridable at runtime via --gpu or NG_DESKTOP_GPU_BACKEND).
gpu.markdownDescription: Native GPU/compositor backend (`auto`, `vulkan`, `gl`, `ngl`, `metal`, `dwm`, `software`). Overridable via `--gpu` or `NG_DESKTOP_GPU_BACKEND`.

appId.description: Reverse-DNS desktop application identifier (e.g. 'com.acme.pokedex') used for .desktop, Flatpak, MSIX, and macOS Info.plist.
appId.markdownDescription: Reverse-DNS application ID (e.g. `com.acme.pokedex`) used for Linux `.desktop`/Flatpak, Windows MSIX, and macOS `Info.plist`.

displayName.description: Human-friendly application name shown in OS launchers, installers, and window titles.

icon.description: Path to primary source icon (.png, .svg, or .ico) used to generate multi-resolution OS icons.

iconSearchDir.description: Directory containing pre-generated multi-resolution application icons (defaults to '<outputPath>/icons').

outputPath.description: Optional output directory override (defaults to 'dist/<projectName>' inherited from architect.build).

main.description: Optional main entrypoint override (inherited from architect.build.options.browser).

projectName.description: Target workspace project name when invoked outside an explicit Architect target.

configPath.description: Optional path to angular.json or project.json.

rebuildIcons.description: Whether to regenerate multi-resolution OS application icons during compilation.

watch.description: Watch source files and push incremental HMR updates over IPC when running dev-server.

version.description: Application release version propagated to runtime config and OS installers.

window.description: Default native window appearance, geometry, and composition hints.

width.description: Default window width in logical pixels.

height.description: Default window height in logical pixels.

minWidth.description: Minimum resizable window width in logical pixels.

minHeight.description: Minimum resizable window height in logical pixels.

resizable.description: Whether the primary native window can be resized by the user.

decorated.description: Whether OS window decorations/titlebar are enabled.

persistGeometry.description: Persist and restore window size, position, and maximized state across launches.

backdrop.description: Windows 11 DWM system backdrop material (ignored on platforms without DWM).

enabled.description: Enable in-process QuickJS-NG server route worker when server routes are present.

routesDir.description: Relative directory containing file-based @ng-desktop/server route handlers.

hmr.description: Development Hot Module Replacement (HMR) IPC settings.

enabled.description: Enable authenticated HMR IPC socket/TCP server during development.

eval.description: Allow authenticated remote JS eval commands over dev HMR IPC.

socketPath.description: Custom Unix domain socket or loopback TCP pointer file path.

permissions.description: Build-time static capability analysis policy and manual allow/deny overrides.
permissions.markdownDescription: Build-time static capability policy (`auto` infers from AST imports; `strict` allows only `allow`).

mode.description: 'auto' infers capabilities from AST usage + overrides; 'strict' grants only 'allow'.

deny.description: Capabilities explicitly revoked even if detected in source files.

packageFormats.description: Distribution package formats emitted by the native packager.
